_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard (#191). `Elemental Resistance` is a compound: {{Elemental Resistance|Elemental|N|...}} grants +N to Acid, Cold, Electricity, and Fire Resistances, and ALSO Sonic when the named parameter `4=` is truthy. The distinction lives in the RENDERED TOOLTIP, not the visible cell -- the cell reads `Elemental Resistance +N` either way -- and gear-planner stores nothing that distinguishes a four-element carrier from a five-element one, so the flag is per-item wiki evidence, exactly as elemental_absorption.json records it for the absorption compound. Single-element invocations ({{Elemental Resistance|Cold|51}}) are stored by gear-planner under the per-element stat name already and never produce an `Elemental Resistance` affix, so they are out of scope here. Entries key affixes by bonus TYPE because two carriers (Epic Chain of Conviction, Epic Death's Rampart) bear two Elemental Resistance affixes with different element sets. Only `stated` is solver-eligible; an absent or non-stated entry is quarantined rather than defaulted in either direction. Every affix record carries a per-item verbatim `tooltip` read from that item's own rendered page: it is the only witness independent of `raw`, because the shared `snapshots` block is keyed BY the invocation. See docs/wiki-evidence/elemental-resistance.md.
